title: StreamAssist Subscription Plans Explained
content: StreamAssist offers three subscription tiers: Basic ($7.99/mo) — SD streaming, 1 device. Standard ($13.99/mo) — HD streaming, 2 devices. Premium ($19.99/mo) — 4K Ultra HD, 4 devices, offline downloads. All plans include unlimited streaming of available titles. To change your plan, go to Account > Subscription > Change Plan. Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrades apply at the end of your current billing cycle.
